# Actions

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask gen-docs` from the action registry. Do not edit. -->

Every action can be dispatched by name with JSON parameters (`host --stdio`, later the UI, scripts and MCP). The tier is checked on every call; `safety` actions are always allowed.

| Action | Tier | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `automation.grants` | read | The permissions the person gave scripts and agents for this session or always (revoked only by the person, in the app). |
| `automation.log` | read | The actions scripts and agents ran or were refused, oldest first (the last 500; `after` skips the entries up to that number). |
| `automation.status` | read | Agents attached to the local endpoint, scripts running, permission requests waiting for the person. |
| `console.get` | read | Console rows (sent commands, answers, messages). |
| `document.add_layer` | edit | Adds a layer of a colour (line, 1000 mm/min, power 1000, 1 pass unless given). One undo step. |
| `document.add_shape` | edit | Draws a rectangle or an ellipse on a layer (default: the current layer) and selects it. One undo step. |
| `document.add_text` | edit | Writes text on a layer (default: the current layer) and selects it: a font of `fonts.list` (default Relief SingleLine, single-line), its style, alignment, spacing and effects. The text stays editable (`document.set_text`). One undo step. |
| `document.align` | edit | Lines up objects (default: the selection, at least two) on the box around them: left, center_h, right, top, middle_v or bottom. One undo step. |
| `document.array` | edit | Copies objects (default: the selection) in a grid of `columns` × `rows` (the originals are the top-left cell; rows go down), `gap_mm` apart; selects the originals and the copies. One undo step. |
| `document.boolean` | edit | Combines shapes (default: the selection, at least two) into one: union (weld), difference (the first in drawing order minus the others), intersection or xor. The result takes the first one's layer and is selected. One undo step. |
| `document.clear_selection` | ui | Selects nothing. |
| `document.combine` | edit | Joins shapes (default: the selection) into one object per layer, so they move together; open paths whose ends touch (0.01 mm) become one continuous path, closed when it comes back to its start. Texts and images are left as they are. The results are selected. One undo step. |
| `document.copy` | ui | Puts copies of objects (default: the selection) and their layers on the session's clipboard, which survives opening another document. Not an undo step. |
| `document.cut` | edit | Puts objects (default: the selection) on the clipboard like `document.copy` and deletes them; the next paste puts them back in place. One undo step. |
| `document.delete` | edit | Deletes objects (default: the selection). One undo step. |
| `document.duplicate` | edit | Copies objects (default: the selection), offset by `offset_mm`, and selects the copies. One undo step. |
| `document.from_fkproj` | edit | Replaces the document with a `.fkproj` text (the undo history starts again). |
| `document.get` | read | The whole document (layers, objects with geometry and images), as in a `.fkproj` file. |
| `document.import` | edit | Imports an SVG, DXF or image file into the document (format from the extension). One undo step. |
| `document.import_data` | edit | Imports a file given as base64 bytes (`data`), or as `text` for SVG and DXF, into the document: SVG and DXF by colour layer (or all on the current layer), images on a layer of their own. Returns the new objects and layers. One undo step. |
| `document.layer_for_color` | edit | The layer of a colour, created (line, 1000 mm/min, power 1000) when missing; it becomes the current layer. Creating it is one undo step. |
| `document.material_test` | edit | Draws a material test (design/ux.md flow 6): a grid of cells, power rising by row and speed by column, each cell on a layer of its own with that power and speed, labelled in single-stroke text on a layer of low power. One undo step. |
| `document.move_layer` | edit | Moves a layer in the layer list (the order of layers of the same mode is the order they run). One undo step. |
| `document.move_to_layer` | edit | Moves objects (default: the selection) to another layer. One undo step. |
| `document.new` | edit | Starts an empty document (the undo history starts again). |
| `document.offset` | edit | Adds the outline of shapes (default: the selection) grown or shrunk by `distance_mm`, as new objects on the same layers, selected; open paths (single-line text) are outlined around their strokes when growing. One undo step. |
| `document.open` | edit | Opens a `.fkproj` project file (the undo history starts again). |
| `document.paste` | edit | Adds the clipboard's objects (`document.copy`, `document.cut`) and selects them: each on the layer of its colour, created with the copied settings when missing. Offset by `offset_mm`, or centred on `at_mm`, by default `[5, -5]` mm once more for every paste in the document they were copied from. One undo step. |
| `document.raster_preview` | read | The bitmap an image object's raster settings (or the ones given) make: grey levels, or black and white when dithered; a PNG, base64. |
| `document.raster_settings` | read | The raster dialog's settings of an image object (tool, dithering, resolution, grey adjustments, speeds, powers). |
| `document.remove_layer` | edit | Removes a layer and its objects. One undo step. |
| `document.save` | edit | Saves the document as a `.fkproj` project file (written atomically). |
| `document.select` | ui | Selects objects (replace, add to or remove from the selection). Unknown ids are ignored. |
| `document.select_all` | ui | Selects every object. |
| `document.set_current_layer` | ui | Chooses the layer new shapes and text go to. |
| `document.set_raster` | edit | Changes the raster dialog's settings of an image object. One undo step. |
| `document.set_text` | edit | Changes a text object: its text, height, font, style, alignment, spacing, effects, or where it sits on its path (its position, rotation and scale stay). One undo step. |
| `document.split` | edit | Splits shapes (default: the selection) made of several paths into one object per path, on the same layer; texts and images are left as they are. The pieces are selected. One undo step. |
| `document.text_off_path` | edit | Takes a text off its path: straight again, its baseline starting where the path starts. One undo step. |
| `document.text_on_path` | edit | Puts a text on the first path of a shape: the letters stand along it, and follow it whenever the shape changes (moved, scaled, edited); moving the text alone puts it back on the path. Deleting the shape leaves the text where it was. One undo step. |
| `document.text_to_paths` | edit | Turns texts (default: the selected ones) into plain shapes: the letters stay, the text is no longer editable. One undo step. |
| `document.to_fkproj` | read | The document as `.fkproj` text. |
| `document.transform` | edit | Moves, scales, mirrors or rotates objects (default: the selection): `{translate}`, `{scale, pivot}`, `{rotate_deg, pivot}` or `{matrix}`. Images only move and scale. One undo step. |
| `document.translate` | edit | Moves objects (default: the selection) by `dx`, `dy` mm. One undo step. |
| `document.update_layer` | edit | Changes a layer's name, mode, speed, power, passes, visibility, filling or laser mode (M3/M4). One undo step. |
| `fire.cancel` | safety | Cancels the pending laser request (the one given, or any). Always allowed. |
| `fire.request` | machine | Asks to run a laser action: it opens the fire confirmation (checklist and countdown) and runs only when a person confirms on screen. Returns the pending request. |
| `fonts.list` | read | The font families a text can use: the built-in single-line fonts first, then the installed ones. |
| `fonts.preview` | read | A sample of a font family as SVG path data (10 mm high, Y down), for font pickers. |
| `history.redo` | edit | Redoes the last undone change. |
| `history.undo` | edit | Undoes the last document change. |
| `job.abort` | safety | Stops streaming the job and sends `M5` (lines already in the board still run; use machine.stop to stop at once). Always allowed. |
| `job.frame` | machine | Runs the head around the bounds of the loaded program with the laser off (jog moves). |
| `job.from_document` | edit | Plans the document (vectors, then images; centerline uses the `autotrace` program) and loads it as the job, placed by `start` (absolute coordinates, the head's current position, or the user origin 0,0) and `anchor` (which point of the job's box goes there). |
| `job.info` | read | The loaded program (name, lines, estimated time, range). |
| `job.load` | edit | Loads and analyzes a G-code file. |
| `job.load_text` | edit | Loads and analyzes G-code given as text. |
| `job.resume` | laser | Runs the loaded program from a position, rebuilding position, power and modes first. Fires the laser. |
| `job.run` | laser | Runs the loaded program from the start (header, program, footer, passes). Fires the laser. |
| `machine.connect` | machine | Connects to the machine on a serial port, or to the built-in emulator. |
| `machine.custom_code` | laser | Runs custom code (buttons, macros): `[expr]` evaluated, immediate characters sent at once. |
| `machine.disconnect` | machine | Closes the connection. |
| `machine.feed_hold` | safety | Feed hold (pause the motion). Always allowed. |
| `machine.home` | machine | Runs the homing cycle (`$H`). |
| `machine.info` | read | Work area, laser mode, highest power and laser module counters, from the board settings. |
| `machine.jog` | machine | Jogs one step in a direction (laser off). |
| `machine.jog_stop` | safety | Stops a continuous jog. Always allowed. |
| `machine.jog_to` | machine | Jogs to a work position (laser off). |
| `machine.list_ports` | read | Serial ports found on this computer. |
| `machine.overrides` | machine | Sets the override targets; the host steps the board towards them. |
| `machine.read_settings` | machine | Reads the board settings again (`$$`). |
| `machine.resume` | machine | Resumes after a feed hold or a door (cycle start). |
| `machine.safety_door` | safety | Safety door (real-time 0x84): the board holds as if its door opened; resume with machine.resume. Always allowed. |
| `machine.select_laser` | edit | Selects the laser module in use (life counters). |
| `machine.send` | laser | Sends one line of G-code or a `$` command (not during a job). It can turn the laser on. |
| `machine.set_zero` | machine | Sets the current position as work zero (`G92 X0 Y0 Z0`). |
| `machine.stop` | safety | STOP: cancels running scripts, then soft resets the board (laser off, queues flushed). Always allowed. |
| `machine.system_command` | machine | Sends a `$` command (`$$`, `$I`, `$H`, `$X`, `$N=V`, `$J=...`; not during a job). It cannot turn the laser on. |
| `machine.unlock` | machine | Unlocks the alarm state (`$X`). |
| `machine.write_settings` | machine | Writes board settings (`$N=V`), one at a time; returns when the board answered all of them. |
| `migrate.detect` | read | What can be imported from LaserGRBL's data folder (`path`, default: LaserGRBL's folder on this computer): connection, preferences, laser counters, custom buttons, materials. Nothing is written. |
| `migrate.run` | edit | Imports the chosen items from LaserGRBL's data folder into FreeKerf's settings, machine cache and macro folder. LaserGRBL's files are only read. |
| `session.snapshot` | read | The session as front ends and agents read it: revision, selection, view, undo/redo labels, layers and objects without geometry. |
| `settings.get` | read | Reads the settings (all, or one dotted key). |
| `settings.set` | edit | Changes one setting and saves the file. Automation settings are user-only and refused here. |
| `state.get` | read | Machine state, loaded program, issues and resume offer. |
| `view.close_dialog` | ui | Closes a dialog (default: the top one). Closing the fire confirmation drops its laser request. |
| `view.close_panel` | ui | Closes the drawer when it shows this panel. |
| `view.dismiss_toast` | ui | Removes a toast. |
| `view.fit` | ui | Fits the work area in the canvas. |
| `view.focus` | ui | Records which element has the keyboard focus. |
| `view.get` | read | The view: mode, tool, panel, dialogs, toasts, viewport, focus, the pending laser request. |
| `view.open_dialog` | ui | Opens a dialog on top of the others (dialogs are not modal: STOP stays reachable). |
| `view.open_panel` | ui | Shows a panel of the dock (`layers`, `object`, `machine`, `console`; opens the drawer in the medium layout). |
| `view.set_mode` | ui | Switches between design and produce (produce shows the machine panel). |
| `view.set_tool` | ui | Chooses the Design mode tool (select, rectangle, ellipse, text). |
| `view.set_viewport` | ui | Centres the view on a point (mm) at a zoom (CSS pixels per mm). |
| `view.toast` | ui | Shows a short message (at most 3 at once); returns its id. |

## Parameters

### `automation.grants`

The permissions the person gave scripts and agents for this session or always (revoked only by the person, in the app).

No parameters.

### `automation.log`

The actions scripts and agents ran or were refused, oldest first (the last 500; `after` skips the entries up to that number).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `after` | no | Only the entries after this `seq`. |

### `automation.status`

Agents attached to the local endpoint, scripts running, permission requests waiting for the person.

No parameters.

### `console.get`

Console rows (sent commands, answers, messages).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `last` | no | Only the last `last` rows. |

### `document.add_layer`

Adds a layer of a colour (line, 1000 mm/min, power 1000, 1 pass unless given). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | yes | Colour, `#RRGGBB`. |
| `fill_pattern` | no | Filling pattern. |
| `laser_mode` | no | Laser on command: `machine` (the machine's), `constant` (`M3`) or `dynamic` (`M4`). |
| `lines_per_mm` | no | Filling lines per mm. |
| `mode` | no | `line`, `fill`, `fill_and_line`, `cut` or `ignore`. |
| `name` | no | Name. |
| `passes` | no | Passes (at least 1). |
| `power` | no | `S` power. |
| `speed_mm_min` | no | Speed, mm/min. |
| `visible` | no | Shown and planned. |

### `document.add_shape`

Draws a rectangle or an ellipse on a layer (default: the current layer) and selects it. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | yes | Height, mm (positive). |
| `layer` | no | Layer id (default: the current layer; a black layer when there is none). |
| `shape` | yes | `rect` or `ellipse`. |
| `width` | yes | Width, mm (positive). |
| `x` | yes | Left, mm. |
| `y` | yes | Bottom, mm (Y up). |

### `document.add_text`

Writes text on a layer (default: the current layer) and selects it: a font of `fonts.list` (default Relief SingleLine, single-line), its style, alignment, spacing and effects. The text stays editable (`document.set_text`). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | no | Alignment of the lines. |
| `arc_radius_mm` | no | Bend the text on a circle of this radius, mm (negative: along its bottom; 0: straight). Not for a text on a path. |
| `bold` | no | Bold. |
| `font` | no | Font family (`fonts.list`; default for a new text: Relief SingleLine). |
| `height_mm` | no | Height of the capitals, mm (default 10). |
| `italic` | no | Italic. |
| `layer` | no | Layer id (default: the current layer; a black layer when there is none). |
| `letter_spacing_mm` | no | Space added between letters, mm (default 0). |
| `line_spacing` | no | Distance between baselines, times the font's line height (default 1). |
| `outline_mm` | no | Add an outline this far around the letters, mm (negative: inside; 0: none). |
| `stencil_mm` | no | Outline fonts: stencil bridges this wide, mm (0: none). |
| `strikethrough` | no | Struck through. |
| `text` | yes | The text; `\n` starts a new line. |
| `underline` | no | Underlined. |
| `weld` | no | Outline fonts: merge overlapping letters into one shape. |
| `width_scale` | no | Horizontal scale of the letters (default 1). |
| `x` | yes | Where the first baseline starts (left), is centred or ends (right), mm. |
| `y` | yes | Baseline of the first line, mm (Y up). |

### `document.align`

Lines up objects (default: the selection, at least two) on the box around them: left, center_h, right, top, middle_v or bottom. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `how` | yes | Which edge or centre. |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection; at least two). |

### `document.array`

Copies objects (default: the selection) in a grid of `columns` × `rows` (the originals are the top-left cell; rows go down), `gap_mm` apart; selects the originals and the copies. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | yes | Columns (at least 1). |
| `gap_mm` | no | Gap between copies, `[x, y]` mm (default `[5, 5]`); rows go down. |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |
| `rows` | yes | Rows (at least 1). |

### `document.boolean`

Combines shapes (default: the selection, at least two) into one: union (weld), difference (the first in drawing order minus the others), intersection or xor. The result takes the first one's layer and is selected. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection; at least two shapes). |
| `op` | yes | The operation. |

### `document.clear_selection`

Selects nothing.

No parameters.

### `document.combine`

Joins shapes (default: the selection) into one object per layer, so they move together; open paths whose ends touch (0.01 mm) become one continuous path, closed when it comes back to its start. Texts and images are left as they are. The results are selected. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.copy`

Puts copies of objects (default: the selection) and their layers on the session's clipboard, which survives opening another document. Not an undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.cut`

Puts objects (default: the selection) on the clipboard like `document.copy` and deletes them; the next paste puts them back in place. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.delete`

Deletes objects (default: the selection). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.duplicate`

Copies objects (default: the selection), offset by `offset_mm`, and selects the copies. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |
| `offset_mm` | no | Offset of the copies, `[dx, dy]` mm (default `[5, -5]`: right and down). |

### `document.from_fkproj`

Replaces the document with a `.fkproj` text (the undo history starts again).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | yes | The project file's text (`.fkproj`, JSON). |

### `document.get`

The whole document (layers, objects with geometry and images), as in a `.fkproj` file.

No parameters.

### `document.import`

Imports an SVG, DXF or image file into the document (format from the extension). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | Path of a G-code file. |

### `document.import_data`

Imports a file given as base64 bytes (`data`), or as `text` for SVG and DXF, into the document: SVG and DXF by colour layer (or all on the current layer), images on a layer of their own. Returns the new objects and layers. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `colors` | no | Drawings: `keep` the colour layers (default), or `unify` everything on the current layer. |
| `data` | no | The file's bytes, base64 (or `text`). |
| `dpi` | no | Images: resolution in dots per inch (default 96); position is the origin. |
| `format` | yes | File format. |
| `name` | no | Name of the file (kept as the objects' source). |
| `power` | no | Power of new layers, `S` (default 1000). |
| `speed_mm_min` | no | Speed of new layers, mm/min (default 1000). |
| `text` | no | SVG or DXF: the file as text instead of `data` (for scripts that build a drawing). |

### `document.layer_for_color`

The layer of a colour, created (line, 1000 mm/min, power 1000) when missing; it becomes the current layer. Creating it is one undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | yes | Colour, `#RRGGBB`. |

### `document.material_test`

Draws a material test (design/ux.md flow 6): a grid of cells, power rising by row and speed by column, each cell on a layer of its own with that power and speed, labelled in single-stroke text on a layer of low power. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cell_mm` | no | Side of a cell, mm (default 10). |
| `gap_mm` | no | Gap between cells, mm (default 3). |
| `max_s` | no | The machine's `$30` (the `S` of 100 %; default 1000). |
| `mode` | no | Filled squares or outlines (default: fill). |
| `origin` | no | Bottom-left corner of the grid, mm (default 0, 0). |
| `power_pct` | yes | Power, % of `max_s` (rows, bottom to top). |
| `speed_mm_min` | yes | Speed, mm/min (columns, left to right). |

### `document.move_layer`

Moves a layer in the layer list (the order of layers of the same mode is the order they run). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Layer id. |
| `to` | yes | New position in the layer list (0 is first; past the end means last). |

### `document.move_to_layer`

Moves objects (default: the selection) to another layer. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |
| `layer` | yes | Layer id. |

### `document.new`

Starts an empty document (the undo history starts again).

No parameters.

### `document.offset`

Adds the outline of shapes (default: the selection) grown or shrunk by `distance_mm`, as new objects on the same layers, selected; open paths (single-line text) are outlined around their strokes when growing. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `distance_mm` | yes | Distance, mm: positive grows, negative shrinks. |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |
| `join` | no | Corners. |

### `document.open`

Opens a `.fkproj` project file (the undo history starts again).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | Path of a G-code file. |

### `document.paste`

Adds the clipboard's objects (`document.copy`, `document.cut`) and selects them: each on the layer of its colour, created with the copied settings when missing. Offset by `offset_mm`, or centred on `at_mm`, by default `[5, -5]` mm once more for every paste in the document they were copied from. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `at_mm` | no | Centre of the pasted objects, `[x, y]` mm (e.g. where the context menu was opened; `offset_mm` wins when both are given). |
| `offset_mm` | no | Offset of the copies, `[dx, dy]` mm (default: `[5, -5]` once more for every paste in the document copied from; none for the first paste in another document or after a cut). |

### `document.raster_preview`

The bitmap an image object's raster settings (or the ones given) make: grey levels, or black and white when dithered; a PNG, base64.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of an image object. |
| `settings` | no | Settings to try (default: the image's own). |

### `document.raster_settings`

The raster dialog's settings of an image object (tool, dithering, resolution, grey adjustments, speeds, powers).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of an image object. |

### `document.remove_layer`

Removes a layer and its objects. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Layer id. |

### `document.save`

Saves the document as a `.fkproj` project file (written atomically).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | Path of a G-code file. |

### `document.select`

Selects objects (replace, add to or remove from the selection). Unknown ids are ignored.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | yes | Object ids. |
| `mode` | no | Replace (default), add or remove. |

### `document.select_all`

Selects every object.

No parameters.

### `document.set_current_layer`

Chooses the layer new shapes and text go to.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Layer id. |

### `document.set_raster`

Changes the raster dialog's settings of an image object. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of an image object. |
| `settings` | yes | The raster dialog's settings (all of them, as `document.raster_settings` gives). |

### `document.set_text`

Changes a text object: its text, height, font, style, alignment, spacing, effects, or where it sits on its path (its position, rotation and scale stay). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | no | Alignment of the lines. |
| `arc_radius_mm` | no | Bend the text on a circle of this radius, mm (negative: along its bottom; 0: straight). Not for a text on a path. |
| `bold` | no | Bold. |
| `font` | no | Font family (`fonts.list`; default for a new text: Relief SingleLine). |
| `height_mm` | no | New height of the capitals, mm. |
| `id` | yes | Id of a text object. |
| `italic` | no | Italic. |
| `letter_spacing_mm` | no | Space added between letters, mm (default 0). |
| `line_spacing` | no | Distance between baselines, times the font's line height (default 1). |
| `outline_mm` | no | Add an outline this far around the letters, mm (negative: inside; 0: none). |
| `path_distance_mm` | no | On a path: distance of the baseline from it, mm. |
| `path_flip` | no | On a path: follow it backwards (the other side). |
| `path_offset_mm` | no | On a path: where the text starts along it, mm. |
| `stencil_mm` | no | Outline fonts: stencil bridges this wide, mm (0: none). |
| `strikethrough` | no | Struck through. |
| `text` | no | New text. |
| `underline` | no | Underlined. |
| `weld` | no | Outline fonts: merge overlapping letters into one shape. |
| `width_scale` | no | Horizontal scale of the letters (default 1). |

### `document.split`

Splits shapes (default: the selection) made of several paths into one object per path, on the same layer; texts and images are left as they are. The pieces are selected. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.text_off_path`

Takes a text off its path: straight again, its baseline starting where the path starts. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of a text object. |

### `document.text_on_path`

Puts a text on the first path of a shape: the letters stand along it, and follow it whenever the shape changes (moved, scaled, edited); moving the text alone puts it back on the path. Deleting the shape leaves the text where it was. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `distance_mm` | no | Distance of the baseline from the path, mm (default 0). |
| `flip` | no | Follow the path backwards (default false). |
| `id` | yes | Id of a text object. |
| `offset_mm` | no | Where the text starts along the path, mm (default 0). |
| `path` | yes | Id of the shape whose first path the text follows (it follows it when it changes). |

### `document.text_to_paths`

Turns texts (default: the selected ones) into plain shapes: the letters stay, the text is no longer editable. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.to_fkproj`

The document as `.fkproj` text.

No parameters.

### `document.transform`

Moves, scales, mirrors or rotates objects (default: the selection): `{translate}`, `{scale, pivot}`, `{rotate_deg, pivot}` or `{matrix}`. Images only move and scale. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |
| `op` | yes | The transform. |

### `document.translate`

Moves objects (default: the selection) by `dx`, `dy` mm. One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dx` | yes | Distance along X, mm. |
| `dy` | yes | Distance along Y, mm. |
| `ids` | no | Object ids (default: the selection). |

### `document.update_layer`

Changes a layer's name, mode, speed, power, passes, visibility, filling or laser mode (M3/M4). One undo step.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fill_pattern` | no | Filling pattern. |
| `id` | yes | Layer id. |
| `laser_mode` | no | Laser on command: `machine` (the machine's), `constant` (`M3`) or `dynamic` (`M4`). |
| `lines_per_mm` | no | Filling lines per mm. |
| `mode` | no | `line`, `fill`, `fill_and_line`, `cut` or `ignore`. |
| `name` | no | Name. |
| `passes` | no | Passes (at least 1). |
| `power` | no | `S` power. |
| `speed_mm_min` | no | Speed, mm/min. |
| `visible` | no | Shown and planned. |

### `fire.cancel`

Cancels the pending laser request (the one given, or any). Always allowed.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | no | The request; the pending one when absent. |

### `fire.request`

Asks to run a laser action: it opens the fire confirmation (checklist and countdown) and runs only when a person confirms on screen. Returns the pending request.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | yes | An action of tier `laser` (`job.run`, `job.resume`, `machine.send`, `machine.custom_code`). |
| `params` | no | Its parameters. |

### `fonts.list`

The font families a text can use: the built-in single-line fonts first, then the installed ones.

No parameters.

### `fonts.preview`

A sample of a font family as SVG path data (10 mm high, Y down), for font pickers.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bold` | no | Bold. |
| `family` | yes | Font family. |
| `italic` | no | Italic. |
| `text` | no | Sample text (default `AaBbÇç 123`). |

### `history.redo`

Redoes the last undone change.

No parameters.

### `history.undo`

Undoes the last document change.

No parameters.

### `job.abort`

Stops streaming the job and sends `M5` (lines already in the board still run; use machine.stop to stop at once). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `job.frame`

Runs the head around the bounds of the loaded program with the laser off (jog moves).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed_mm_min` | no | Feed in mm/min (default: the jog setting). |

### `job.from_document`

Plans the document (vectors, then images; centerline uses the `autotrace` program) and loads it as the job, placed by `start` (absolute coordinates, the head's current position, or the user origin 0,0) and `anchor` (which point of the job's box goes there).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | no | Which point of the job's box goes to the start point (not used when absolute). |
| `start` | no | Where the job starts (default: absolute). |

### `job.info`

The loaded program (name, lines, estimated time, range).

No parameters.

### `job.load`

Loads and analyzes a G-code file.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | yes | Path of a G-code file. |

### `job.load_text`

Loads and analyzes G-code given as text.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gcode` | yes | The G-code. |
| `name` | yes | Name shown for the program. |

### `job.resume`

Runs the loaded program from a position, rebuilding position, power and modes first. Fires the laser.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `homing` | no | Home first. |
| `position` | yes | 0-based index of the first command to run. |
| `set_wco` | no | Restore the work offset of the interrupted job. |

### `job.run`

Runs the loaded program from the start (header, program, footer, passes). Fires the laser.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `homing` | no | Home (`$H`) before the job. |
| `passes` | no | Number of passes (default 1). |

### `machine.connect`

Connects to the machine on a serial port, or to the built-in emulator.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baud` | no | Baud rate; default: from the settings (115200). |
| `emulator` | no | Connect to the built-in emulator instead of a serial port. |
| `port` | no | Serial port (`/dev/ttyUSB0`, `COM3`); default: the last one used. |

### `machine.custom_code`

Runs custom code (buttons, macros): `[expr]` evaluated, immediate characters sent at once.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | yes | Lines of custom code (`[expr]`, `!`, `~`, `?`, `ctrl-x`, `0xNN` allowed). |

### `machine.disconnect`

Closes the connection.

No parameters.

### `machine.feed_hold`

Feed hold (pause the motion). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.home`

Runs the homing cycle (`$H`).

No parameters.

### `machine.info`

Work area, laser mode, highest power and laser module counters, from the board settings.

No parameters.

### `machine.jog`

Jogs one step in a direction (laser off).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | yes | `N`, `S`, `E`, `W`, `NE`, `NW`, `SE`, `SW`, `Zup`, `Zdown` or `Home`. |
| `feed_mm_min` | no | Feed in mm/min (default: the jog setting). |
| `step_mm` | no | Step in mm (default: the jog setting). |

### `machine.jog_stop`

Stops a continuous jog. Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.jog_to`

Jogs to a work position (laser off).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed_mm_min` | no | Feed in mm/min (default: the jog setting). |
| `x` | yes | Target X (work coordinates, mm). |
| `y` | yes | Target Y (work coordinates, mm). |

### `machine.list_ports`

Serial ports found on this computer.

No parameters.

### `machine.overrides`

Sets the override targets; the host steps the board towards them.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feed` | yes | Feed override target, % (10-200). |
| `power` | yes | Power override target, % (10-200). |
| `rapid` | yes | Rapid override target, % (25, 50 or 100). |

### `machine.read_settings`

Reads the board settings again (`$$`).

No parameters.

### `machine.resume`

Resumes after a feed hold or a door (cycle start).

No parameters.

### `machine.safety_door`

Safety door (real-time 0x84): the board holds as if its door opened; resume with machine.resume. Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.select_laser`

Selects the laser module in use (life counters).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id of the laser life counter. |

### `machine.send`

Sends one line of G-code or a `$` command (not during a job). It can turn the laser on.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | yes | One line of G-code or a `$` command. |

### `machine.set_zero`

Sets the current position as work zero (`G92 X0 Y0 Z0`).

No parameters.

### `machine.stop`

STOP: cancels running scripts, then soft resets the board (laser off, queues flushed). Always allowed.

No parameters.

### `machine.system_command`

Sends a `$` command (`$$`, `$I`, `$H`, `$X`, `$N=V`, `$J=...`; not during a job). It cannot turn the laser on.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | yes | A `$` command (`$$`, `$I`, `$H`, `$X`, `$#`, `$G`, `$N=V`, `$J=...`): never turns the laser on. Other G-code goes through `machine.send` (tier `laser`). |

### `machine.unlock`

Unlocks the alarm state (`$X`).

No parameters.

### `machine.write_settings`

Writes board settings (`$N=V`), one at a time; returns when the board answered all of them.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settings` | yes | Values by setting number (`{"110": "6000"}`). |

### `migrate.detect`

What can be imported from LaserGRBL's data folder (`path`, default: LaserGRBL's folder on this computer): connection, preferences, laser counters, custom buttons, materials. Nothing is written.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | no | LaserGRBL's data folder (default: its folder on this computer). |

### `migrate.run`

Imports the chosen items from LaserGRBL's data folder into FreeKerf's settings, machine cache and macro folder. LaserGRBL's files are only read.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | yes | What to import. |
| `path` | no | LaserGRBL's data folder (default: its folder on this computer). |

### `session.snapshot`

The session as front ends and agents read it: revision, selection, view, undo/redo labels, layers and objects without geometry.

No parameters.

### `settings.get`

Reads the settings (all, or one dotted key).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | no | Dotted key (`machine.baud`); all settings when absent. |

### `settings.set`

Changes one setting and saves the file. Automation settings are user-only and refused here.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | yes | Dotted key (`machine.streaming_mode`). `automation.*` is user-only. |
| `value` | yes | New value (JSON). |

### `state.get`

Machine state, loaded program, issues and resume offer.

No parameters.

### `view.close_dialog`

Closes a dialog (default: the top one). Closing the fire confirmation drops its laser request.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | no | The dialog (default: the one on top). |

### `view.close_panel`

Closes the drawer when it shows this panel.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | `layers`, `object`, `machine` or `console`. |

### `view.dismiss_toast`

Removes a toast.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Id returned by `view.toast`. |

### `view.fit`

Fits the work area in the canvas.

No parameters.

### `view.focus`

Records which element has the keyboard focus.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | no | Element with the focus (`canvas`, `console`...), none when absent. |

### `view.get`

The view: mode, tool, panel, dialogs, toasts, viewport, focus, the pending laser request.

No parameters.

### `view.open_dialog`

Opens a dialog on top of the others (dialogs are not modal: STOP stays reachable).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | The dialog (`settings`, `shortcuts`, `recover`, `welcome`, `import`, `raster`, `about`...). |

### `view.open_panel`

Shows a panel of the dock (`layers`, `object`, `machine`, `console`; opens the drawer in the medium layout).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | `layers`, `object`, `machine` or `console`. |

### `view.set_mode`

Switches between design and produce (produce shows the machine panel).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | yes | `design` or `produce`. |

### `view.set_tool`

Chooses the Design mode tool (select, rectangle, ellipse, text).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tool` | yes | `select`, `rect`, `ellipse` or `text`. |

### `view.set_viewport`

Centres the view on a point (mm) at a zoom (CSS pixels per mm).

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `center` | yes | Centre `[x, y]`, mm. |
| `zoom` | yes | Zoom, CSS pixels per mm. |

### `view.toast`

Shows a short message (at most 3 at once); returns its id.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `args` | no | Placeholders of the message. |
| `level` | no | `info` (default), `ok`, `warning` or `error`. |
| `message` | yes | i18n key (or plain text). |
